result:
If I could make one real, permanent change, it would be to close the gap between what people know and how they act on it.

Not more information. We already have too much. What’s missing is the reflex to care when it costs something — time, money, status, comfort.

A world where empathy wasn't just a feeling you have in private, but a default you can't easily override with convenience, tribalism, or fear. Where it's as hard to ignore someone else's pain as it is to ignore your own.

Everything else — less war, less poverty, better health, cleaner planet — tends to follow from that.
